How do I use it properly the very first time?
For the Mini Mod and Cherry Vanilla melts we discussed, here’s a simple first run:
Put the warmer on a level, heat-resistant surface, with its cord away from the edge and hot surfaces.
Make sure the silicone dish is in place, then add 1–2 wax melt bears. You don’t need an extra liner.
Plug in the warmer and choose a timer setting. Three hours is a good short first try.
Turn it off when you leave the room or go to sleep, even if you’ve set the timer. Don’t move it while the wax is hot.
When the wax is completely cool and hard, lift out the silicone dish and pop the wax out when you’re ready to change it.
